result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products whose quantity is 0.

The change is one condition, `AND s.quantity > 0`, in the query behind `DataStore.listStockByWarehouse` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 1491). `findStockQuantity` is untouched, so asking for the nuts in WH-1 still answers 0.

The full `mvn -o test` run finished with exit code 0 and no failures. I also ran the stock tests and `DemoScenarioTest` on their own, and they passed. I didn't add a new test for the zero-quantity case.
